goals.2: Staying safe on the internet: Datenschutz
dialog.1.de.0.n: je + comparative …, desto + comparative: the more … the …
dialog.4.de.4.n: privat stellen = to set to private
grammar.0.title: je … desto: two comparatives
grammar.0.text: A je clause is a subordinate clause (verb at the end). After desto comes the main clause: verb in second place (desto + comparative counts as the first part).
grammar.1.title: je … desto — examples
grammar.1.note: immer + comparative = more and more: „Es wird immer wärmer.“ (It's getting warmer and warmer), „Ich lerne immer mehr.“
grammar.1.rows.0.1: The earlier you come, the better.
grammar.1.rows.1.1: The more I practise, the easier German becomes.
grammar.1.rows.2.1: The older people get, the calmer they become.
grammar.1.rows.3.1: The cheaper it is, the more people like it.
grammar.2.title: Words for staying safe online
grammar.2.note: In the EU your personal data is protected (DSGVO). Don't click on unknown links and don't give your password to anyone.
quiz.6.why: je clause: verb at the end.
